title: A non-modal offcanvas panel that allows page scrolling must not trap keyboard focus
summary: With body scrolling enabled and no backdrop, every attempt to Tab to a page control behind the open offcanvas pulls focus back into the panel, so keyboard users cannot use the page while the panel is open.
consumer: Author-written expense report page with a scroll-enabled, backdrop-free help panel around the unchanged upstream source at buggyCommit; transitions are disabled in page CSS and an import map adds the .js extensions Bootstrap's extensionless source imports need in a browser.
